ageing_relevance.rationale: B2M is a GrimAge plasma-protein component and ~10% of its papers concern ageing, but Open Targets lists no age-related disease associations and the DNAm surrogate is not measured protein. Ageing evidence rests on literature and the clock context.

evidence.value: One of seven plasma proteins whose DNA-methylation surrogates make up GrimAge, the mortality clock that was +4.3 years older in schizophrenia in part 1 of this project (an effect explained by smoking). The surrogates are methylation estimates, not measured protein levels.

background_knowledge: Circulating B2M rises with age and is reported in mouse studies to impair cognition and neurogenesis (Smith et al. 2015).
B2M is a marker of renal function and mortality in older adults.

mechanism.rationale: B2M's role in MHC class I is well understood. Its causal role in ageing is less clear, because the protein is both a marker and a possible mediator. Lowering circulating B2M is the plausible direction, but systemic MHC-I function must be preserved.

evidence.value: Component of the class I major histocompatibility complex (MHC). Involved in the presentation of peptide antigens to the immune system.

background_knowledge: Elevated circulating B2M is linked to dialysis-related amyloidosis and is a biomarker of ageing.

tractability.rationale: Small-molecule evidence is a ligand-bound structure and a high-quality pocket. Antibody tractability is supported by the secreted and cell-surface location, and PROTAC features are present. There are no approved drugs, and the target is a small, abundant protein.

safety.rationale: No liabilities are listed, but absence of data is not evidence of safety. B2M is essential for MHC class I surface expression, so inhibition risks immune deficiency, as shown by the MHC class I deficiency association and the loss of antigen presentation. Loss of function in tumours also causes immunotherapy resistance.
background_knowledge: B2M knockout mice lack CD8 T cells and have impaired immunity.
B2M loss-of-function mutations in tumours are linked to resistance to checkpoint inhibitors.

clinical_precedence.rationale: No drugs acting on B2M have reached the clinic according to Open Targets.

assessment.summary: B2M is a secreted and cell-surface MHC class I component and one of the GrimAge plasma-protein surrogates. About 10% of its literature concerns ageing, but Open Targets lists no age-related disease associations. The DNAm surrogate is not measured protein, and the schizophrenia link is largely explained by smoking. Tractability is moderate (small-molecule pocket, antibody and PROTAC features), and no drugs have reached the clinic. Safety is the main concern: B2M is essential for MHC class I, and loss of function causes immune deficiency and immunotherapy resistance. I would only pursue it as a biomarker or as selective lowering of circulating B2M, not as systemic inhibition.
key_uncertainties: Whether circulating B2M causes ageing phenotypes in humans or only marks them (renal function confounding).
Whether circulating B2M can be lowered without affecting cell-surface MHC class I.
The GrimAge DNAm surrogate is not a measured protein level.
Evidence for harm from circulating B2M comes mainly from mouse studies.
